evidence.observation: The first-document rule says the root makes "no claim of its own" when it owns "no object type, no fact type, no constraint wherever it is written ... no operation and no obligation." It omits `deontic_notes`. The model schema admits root-owned notes with `text`, so a root containing a textual rule but no documents would meet this exemption.

concerns.recommendation: Count root-owned deontic notes in D4's ownership test and add that case to VG4-C3, or explicitly narrow the no-claim promise and document why notes are exempt.
concerns.title: A root can carry a textual claim with no source document

evidence.observation: The plan says the span walk and counts "cover every root-owned span" and VG3-C5 says "span counts cover root-owned spans." `src/gnd/model/_unattended.py:_iter_unattended_spans` currently walks object types, fact types and constraints, but not operations or obligations; the schema permits provenance on both.

concerns.recommendation: Specify whether operation and obligation spans enter the walk, test the chosen boundary, and reconcile it with §5's promise to preserve acceptance of previously valid roots.
concerns.title: Root-owned operation spans fall outside the specified count

evidence.observation: D5 prints counts of object types, fact types and constraints, plus counts of constraints that are `confirmed`, `alethic`, or `explicit` or `user-supplied`. Section 6 says "Every `gnd validate` prints what each include carries, by status, modality and source (D5)." Those counts omit deontic notes and do not show the other source, status or modality values, or which values occur together.

concerns.recommendation: Either provide the stated attribution, including notes and the relevant claim combinations, or narrow §6's assurance to the counts D5 actually specifies.
concerns.title: Include attribution does not show what §6 claims

summary: The first-document exception omits root-owned deontic notes. Two span and attribution promises also exceed the behavior or detail specified by the plan.
